finalCta.paragraph: History: The EP6CDTX is the most powerful iteration of the Prince engine, producing 270hp in the 308 GTi 270 by Peugeot Sport. This engine features a larger turbocharger and upgraded internal components. It was produced until 2015 and meets Euro 5 emissions standards. The EP6CDTX is also found in the Peugeot RCZ and 208 GTi. The EP6FDTX variant was used in later models.
